content: Many phrases come to mind when thinking of The Witcher series: dark, unforgiving, morally ambiguous, Geralt in a bathtub. According to The Witcher 3 ’s new DLC Songs of the Past principal writer, Alexandra Motyka, this new chapter in Geralt's saga will add a few new adjectives to that list: “We wanted it to be paced differently from other adventures — a slow burn, sentimental, and somehow soothing.”
